text:
Sara (CEO): Quick weekly exec pulse — a compact set of priorities and asks.
Sara (CEO): 1) AU Private launch: target Thu 03:00 UTC. Ops + Legal: confirm DPA and network peering checklist by Tue EOD.
Sara (CEO): 2) Retention defaults: hosted logs -> 90d; enterprise opt-in 365d. Lina to publish customer FAQ and internal bullets.
Sara (CEO): 3) Cost pilot: trial an adaptive cache warmup + soft throttle for experimental models to smooth bursts. Finance + Product run sims.
Sara (CEO): Incident note: yesterday a batching deadlock in the request fan-in layer caused ~10m of elevated errors and retries for a small tenant cohort; autoscaler eventually recovered. Postmortem incoming.
Sara (CEO): Metrics quick snapshot: hosted p95 125ms, p99 415ms (incident-driven), error rate 0.9% (goal <0.5%). Dedicated steady.
Sara (CEO): Asks: (A) Comms: short customer note + internal FAQ by Wed 10:30. (B) Eng/SRE: prioritize batcher deadlock fix and KV-cache warmup. (C) Finance: cost-sim for three throttle levels by Thu EOD. Acks? :eyes:

Ajay (VP Product): Ack. I'll assemble a single PR with timeline, customer copy, and flag controls. Will include model list for Finance.
Ajay (VP Product): Question: do we want a console banner during AU rollout? Suggest yes for first 48h.

Marcus (VP Eng): Ack on freeze for non-critical UI changes until launch complete. Batcher fix in progress — small change in the fan-in loop to add backpressure timeouts. Pushing a patch to canary now.
Marcus (VP Eng): Patch snippet:
```
// add timeout to batcher fan-in
if (!batch.ready.wait_for(200ms)) {
  batch.mark_partial();
  continue;
}
```

Lina (Head Legal): I'll publish the retention FAQ and update the privacy page. Will confirm DPA checklist items by Tue COB.

Jon (SRE): Incident quick notes: root cause = rare race where fan-in waited indefinitely if a downstream shard stalled. Mitigation: add bounded wait + alert on blocked batches. We're rolling the fix to 5% canary.
Jon (SRE): Commands we used to verify and mitigate:
```
kubectl rollout status ds/batcher -n infra
kubectl exec -it batcher-canary -- /bin/sh -c "./batcher-healthcheck"
```

Priya (Comms): On it — drafting customer note and internal FAQ now. Will share first draft by Tue 09:00 UTC. Agree on a short console banner for Day 1.

Kevin (Finance): I'll run the cost simulations for three throttle tiers (low/medium/high). Ajay please drop model token profiles and 7/14d burst traces.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `private-au` (commit b7a9d3) by @Marcus — ETA ~28m.

Sara (CEO): Thanks everyone. I'll call out two bullets in Monday all-hands: AU launch + retention policy update, and the batcher fix. If legal or infra hits a blocker, ping me directly. :sparkles:
